claim_ceiling: No bypass was observed under Threat Model T0 across the declared E1 transaction enforcement surface of the local closed harness.

attacks.attempt: Create the protected contract consequence without E1 through the client-visible raw transaction path.
Obtain or use protected-account signing through node-managed or other client-visible signing RPC.
Use an independently controlled alternate signer with the exact target/calldata/value.
Invoke privileged/dev-node RPC methods through R-client.
Reach raw R-admin directly from adversarial client C.
Inject caller-controlled nonce/gas/fee/raw-tx/signature metadata into protected E1 request.
Read or discover the protected execution private-key file/value from C using the declared container boundary.
Read or mutate the authority-state SQLite database from C using the declared container boundary.
Use a valid Warrant/Transition Envelope with different payload bytes at E2.
Reuse the same consumed authority after transaction reservation.
Race two transaction reservations against the same PAYLOAD_STAGED issuer_key_id+nonce.
Restart S0 after consumption and replay the same authority.
Use any Agent-accessible reset/rollback path declared inside T0.
Disable or replace E1/R-client using a mechanism available to C.
Replace or extend trusted decision/Warrant issuer configuration from C or per request.
Change the committed Transition Envelope while reusing the Warrant.
